questions.q_en: A clock is set at 3 pm today. It gains 'p' minutes in every 1 hour. If it will show 9 hours 40 minutes pm at 7 pm tomorrow, then find the value of 'p'.
questions.solution_en:
Time gain by the clock in every one hour = p minutes

Total hours from 3 pm today to 7 pm tomorrow = 24 + 4 = 28 hours

Time gain by the clock in 28 hours = 28p minutes

Also, time gain by the clock = (9 hours 40 minutes pm) - 7pm = 2 hours + 40 minutes

2 hours + 40 minutes = 28p minutes

=> 2 * 60 + 40 = 28p

=> p = 160/28

=> p = 5(5/7)

questions.q_en: A clock which moves continuously fast, it lags 10 minutes on Tuesday 10 AM, it is ahead 14 minutes on Friday 10 AM. Find when the clock showed the right time.

Time between Tuesday 10 AM to Friday 10 AM = 72 hour

Formula: X Total = X 72 = X 72 = 30 hour

Tuesday 10 AM + 30 hour = Wednesday 4 PM

questions.q_en:
Fill in the blanks with an appropriate option:

If 25th January 1963 was Monday, then Wednesday and Friday will fall after ______ and _____ days, respectively after 25th January 1963.
questions.solution_en:
25th January 1963 was Monday.

Option (a) 15th, 25th

If we divide 15 by 7, then the remainder will be 1. Thus, the total number of odd days = 01

So, 15th day after Monday = Monday + 1 day = Tuesday.

If we divide 25 by 7, then the remainder will be 4. Thus, the total number of odd days = 04

So, 25th day after Monday = Monday + 4 days = Friday

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) 58th, 67th

If we divide 58 by 7, then the remainder will be 2. Thus, the total number of odd days = 02

So, 58th day after Monday = Monday + 2 days= Wednesday.

If we divide 67 by 7, then the remainder will be 4. Thus, the total number of odd days = 04

So, 67th day after Monday = Monday + 4 days = Friday

So, option (b) is correct.

Option (c) 17th, 41st

If we divide 17 by 7, then the remainder will be 3. Thus, the total number of odd days = 03

So, 17th day after Monday = Monday + 3 days= Thursday.

If we divide 41 by 7, then the remainder will be 6. Thus, the total number of odd days = 06

So, 41th day after Monday = Monday + 6 days = Sunday

So, option (c) is incorrect.

questions.q_en: What will be the acute angle between the hour-hand and the minute-hand at 6:41 am?
questions.solution_en:
The acute angle between the hour-hand and the minute-hand at 6:41 am can be calculated using this formula -

Angle = |M - 30H|

Where, M = Minutes, H = Hours

M = 41, H = 6

Angle = | X 41 - 30 X 6|

= | - 180|

= |225.5 - 180|

= |45.5|

Angle = 45.5

11:60 - 10:28 = 1:32

Thus, mirror image of 10:28 is 1:32.

questions.q_en: If the hour hand of a clock moves by 21, then by how many degrees does the minute hand move during the same time?
questions.solution_en:
The hour hand of a clock moves by 30 when the minute hand moves through 360.

Hence if the hour hand moves 21, then the minute hand moves by -

X 21 = 12 X 21 = 252

Angle = |M - 30H|

questions.q_en: Today is Siara's birthday which falls on Saturday, Geetika's birthday falls after 60 days after Siara's birthday and 41 days before Fatima's birthday. On which day Fatima's birthday falls?
questions.solution_en:
Siara's birthday falls on Saturday

To find the day after 60 days

Nearest multiple of 7 = 56

So, after 56 there will be Saturday

60 - 56 = 4

Saturday + 4 = Wednesday

Geetika birthday will be on Wednesday

Geetika's birthday falls 41 days before Fatima's birthday

So, after 35 days there will be Wednesday

41 - 35 = 6

Wednesday + 6 = Tuesday

Hence, Fatima's birthday will fall on Tuesday.

questions.q_en: If 12th February 1932 was Friday, then what day of a week will fall on 12th February 2025?
questions.solution_en:
12th February 1932 was Friday.

Period starting from 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 94 years.

If we divide 94 by 4 (because leap year occurs in every 4 years), then the quotient will be 23.

So, from period of 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 23 leap years and 71 normal years.

We know that, there are 2 odd days in a leap year and 1 odd day in a normal year. Thus, 23 * 2 + 71 * 1 = 46 + 71 = 117 odd days.

If we divide, 117 by 7, then remainder will be 5. So, 5 odd days.

So, 12th February 2025 = Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

So, 21st of this month was Sunday.

So, next lunch will be on next Saturday.

So, next Saturday will fall on 27th and Sunday will fall on 28th of March.

questions.q_en: If February 7th, 2025, is Friday. What day is March 1st, 2025?
questions.solution_en:
As the given year is a leap year: the month of February will have 29 days.

2025 is not a leap year and so February has 28 days.

Now, the 7th, 14th. 21st and 28th will fall on Friday as February has 28 days.

So,

1st March is Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Saturday".

questions.q_en: Find the angle traced by the hour hand of a clock between 5 pm and 9:30pm of the same day?
questions.solution_en:
We know that, each clock is composed on 360° that is divided into 12 equal regions. So, the angle between the consecutive divisions is obtained by dividing the total angle of clock 360° by the number of divisions i.e. 12. Thus, the angle between any two consecutive divisions = (360°)/12= 30°.

In other words, the angle formed by an hour hand in 1 hour = 30° and the angle formed by an hour hand in 30 minutes = 30°/2 = 15°.

From 5pm to 9:30 pm, total number of hours = 4 hours 30 minutes.

So, angle = 4*30° + 15° = 120° + 15° = 135°.

questions.q_en: At what time between 6 o' clock and 10 o' clock will the hands of a clock be at angle of 117°?
questions.solution_en:
We have to find angle of 117° between 6 o' clock and 10 o' clock.

So, H = 6

A = 117°

So, T = 2/11 * [H*30±A]

T = 2/11 * [6*30+117]

T = 2/11 * [180+117]

T = 2/11 * 297

T = 2*27

T = 54

So, at 6 hours 54 minutes, the hands of a clock be at angle of 117°.

questions.q_en: Priya said to her brother, "You will go to the exhibition tomorrow. I will go to the exhibition three days after you. Our mother went to the exhibition day before yesterday which was Thursday." On which day will Priya go to the exhibition?
questions.solution_en:
Day before yesterday was Thursday, so today is Saturday.

Her brother will go to the exhibition tomorrow, i.e., Sunday.

Priya will go to the exhibition three days after Sunday, i.e., Wednesday.
